title: minor BUG:  automation uses mmo instead of the units selected in preferences until you delete the sample.
symptom: When setting up automation (objective 10) as a new user, the pre-defined example for lowBG uses mmol/L units regardless of the user's preference for mg/dL. Even when creating a new automated task while the sample exists, the unit remains mmol/L and cannot be changed. Deleting the sample allows new tasks to use mg/dL.
cause: The sample rule that comes with the app is created with mmol/L units, and existing rules do not update when UI units are changed. The maintainer states that rules use units selected during creation, and changing UI units afterwards has no effect on existing rules.
fix: Delete the provided sample rule; after deletion, new automated tasks will use the units selected in preferences (mg/dL).
evidence_quote: rules use units selected during creation. changing UI units afterwards has no effect on existing rules
